headline: Private Equity Firms Circle UK Commercial Supplier JLA Group
summary: Private equity firms Apax Partners, Nordic Capital, and Dalmore Capital are evaluating potential bids for UK commercial laundry and catering equipment supplier JLA Group, according to Bloomberg.
why: Private equity interest in essential commercial service providers reflects buyout deal flow and credit market activity in UK mid-market infrastructure and support services.

impacts.name: Private Equity
impacts.why: Competing buyout interest indicates active capital deployment for recurring-revenue UK B2B service assets.
